judged_text: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:16 — `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first; host.destroy` (and `save_host(host)` at line 11) calls methods on `nil` when the id no longer exists (row already deleted from another tab/session), producing a NoMethodError 500 instead of a 404 and leaving the client-side `destroyRecord().then(...)` never firing `deleteHost`, so the stale row stays in the admin table (severity P2, confidence 75, advisory)
